claims.source_figure: Bloomberg 25.9.2026: annualized revenue run rate of ~$1B based on September 2026 performance (monthly revenue x12); run rate was $492M in May 2026. Trailing 12-month actual revenue is far below $1B.
claims.note: The headline's 'a billion dollars a year' presents a run rate (one month annualized) as yearly revenue. The lede/body (per snippet) correctly says 'קצב הכנסות שנתי', so the conflation is in the headline only. Given the run rate doubled in ~4 months, actual revenue over the past year is likely well under half of $1B.

claims.claim_text: גוף/פתיח: קוגנישן הצטרפה לליגה מצומצמת של סטארט-אפי AI עם קצב הכנסות שנתי של מיליארד דולר
claims.source_figure: Bloomberg 25.9.2026: Cognition crossed (some syndications: 'on track to hit') a $1B annualized run rate based on September performance, per a person familiar with the matter.
claims.note: Matches the source in the run-rate terminology. Small caveat: some syndications of the Bloomberg piece say 'on track to' $1B rather than having crossed it; the figure comes from an anonymous source / company, not audited financials.

claims.claim_text: גוף: קצב ההכנסות השנתי זינק מ-492 מיליון דולר לכמעט 900 מיליון דולר בתוך ארבעה חודשים
claims.source_figure: Bloomberg 8.9.2026 (funding round report): run rate $492M in May 2026, topped ~$900M before the Series E closed.
claims.note: Consistent with the source. Note it sits alongside the $1B figure in the same piece: ~$900M (early Sept) and ~$1B (Sept performance) are two consecutive data points, not a contradiction.

claims.claim_text: כותרת: מסגור ההשוואה, ענקית AI שתאיים על OpenAI ואנתרופיק (בהינתן מיליארד דולר בשנה)
claims.source_figure: OpenAI run rate ~$40B+ (TheMarker itself, 14.8.2026); Anthropic run rate ~$65B at end of July 2026 (Fortune 18.8.2026), with higher figures reported for later. Claude Code alone passed a $2.5B run rate already in Feb 2026.
claims.note: Borderline scope: the headline is a question, so the threat itself is not verdicted. But the headline sets the $1B figure against OpenAI/Anthropic: Cognition's run rate is ~1.5-2.5% of theirs, and below the coding product of one of them (Claude Code). The lede narrows it to 'in the coding field', which the headline drops. Calling it a 'giant' on the strength of this figure inflates the comparison's scale.

audit_note: Worst verdict: overstated (headline comparison scale). Core figure ($1B run rate, $492M->~$900M) matches Bloomberg as reported via syndication; headline turns run rate into 'per year' (imprecise). Valuation ($48B) and the $2B raise are excluded as company-valuation/market data. Article and Bloomberg both egress-blocked; reconstructed from multiple consistent search snippets - medium confidence.
